Practice set: Principles of Assessment

1. Which quality of a test refers to the consistency of its scores when it is given again to the same group?

A. Validity

B. Reliability

C. Usability

D. Objectivity

Answer: B

Explanation: Reliability is consistency; validity is accuracy.

2) A teacher checks understanding with an exit card at the end of class. This is

a) diagnostic assessment

b) formative assessment

c) summative assessment

d) placement testing

Ans: b

3. This item has only two choices and should be ignored

A. One

B. Two
